title_en: Solar and Wind Power in China
note_en: The frame 随 A 而 B means "B happens as A changes": 发电量会随天气变化而波动 "output fluctuates with the weather." 随 introduces the thing that drives the change and 而 links it to the verb that follows, a bookish pattern found in news and science writing. Compare 随之 later in the text (比重也会随之进一步提高), where 之 stands for "that" and means "along with it."
